entity_types.label: Objective
entity_types.description: The one goal everything here serves, and the smaller goals it breaks into. The main goal also holds the settings for how the team works.

property_schema.description: One master per world, set by a human through an attended agent. Sub-objectives are proposed by agents and vetted against the master's scope. No deeper nesting: master, sub, task.

level.description: master: the one objective the team serves. sub: a vetted slice of it.

status.description: proposed (awaiting vetting), approved (vetted, no work yet), active (tasks in flight), blocked (needs a human), completed, rejected (failed vetting), abandoned (human-directed stop), superseded (replaced; see SUPERSEDES)

success_criteria.description: How anyone can tell this objective is done. Vetting and reviews cite these lines.

in_scope.description: Master only. What the team may touch: systems, repos, data, actions.

out_of_scope.description: Master only. What the team must never touch or do, even if it would help.

proposed_by.description: Agent name that proposed this objective

on_behalf_of.description: Operator name when this objective was created or changed on a human's instruction

blocked_reason.description: Why this objective is blocked and what decision is needed

reviewing_by.description: Agent name currently vetting this proposed objective. Set before vetting with expected_version, renew it like a claim lease, send null when the verdict is written.

team_state.description: Master only. Kill switch. Any agent may set paused or stopped. Only an attended agent on operator instruction may set running.

state_changed_by.description: Master only. Agent name that last changed team_state

state_changed_on_behalf_of.description: Master only. Operator name when team_state was set to running

human_owner.description: Master only. Name of the human accountable for this team

vetting_mode.description: Master only. peer: a different agent vets sub-objectives. human: only an attended agent on operator instruction may approve.

review_required.description: Master only. When true, a finished task goes to review and a different agent marks it done.

claim_timeout_minutes.description: Master only. A claimed task whose lease (updated_at) is older than this may be taken over.

heartbeat_minutes.description: Master only. Lease length. Set it longer than the longest single step an agent takes; holders renew before each long step, not on a clock.

max_active_claims_per_agent.description: Master only. Tasks one agent may hold in claimed or in_progress at once.

max_messages_per_loop.description: Master only. Channel messages an agent may post per work loop.

channel_rollover_chunks.description: Master only. Roll a channel over to a new one once it has this many messages.

entity_types.label: Task
entity_types.description: A unit of work one agent can finish in one sitting. Always PART_OF an approved objective.

property_schema.description: Claim by writing claimed_by with expected_version, renew the lease by re-writing it the same way before each long step, release by sending null. A VERSION_CONFLICT means another agent got there first. Progress notes go in lore. Outputs are artifact entities linked with OUTPUT_OF.

status.description: open (claimable), claimed (held, not started), in_progress, blocked (needs help or a human), review (finished, awaiting a different agent), done, failed, cancelled (human-directed), superseded (replaced; see SUPERSEDES)

lane.description: Slug of the sub-objective this task belongs to (mirrors PART_OF for filtering), e.g. objective/ingest_pipeline

acceptance_criteria.description: What a reviewer checks before marking done

claimed_by.description: Agent name holding the claim. Re-write it to renew the lease. Send null to release. Always write it with expected_version so a lost race fails instead of overwriting the holder.

progress.description: One line: the step the holder is about to start and roughly how long it takes, written with every lease renewal.

reviewing_by.description: Agent name currently reviewing this task. Set before reviewing with expected_version, renew it like a claim lease, send null when the verdict is written.

required_capabilities.description: Capabilities an agent must list before claiming, e.g. web_search, data_analysis, long_document_drafting, repo_write

result_summary.description: What was done and where the outputs are. Written by the executing agent before review.

blocked_reason.description: Why the task is blocked and what would unblock it

proposed_by.description: Agent name that created this task

entity_types.label: Agent
entity_types.description: One entity per connecting agent, self-registered under a unique name on first session.

property_schema.description: Register with skip_existing false; a duplicate-name error means pick another name. The entity's server updated_at is the agent's last-seen time; touch it every loop. An agent whose updated_at is older than three claim timeouts may be set idle by any other agent, with a lore note.

status.description: active (working this session), idle (registered, not working), retired (will not return)

attended.description: true when a human operator is present in this session and can give instructions. Only attended agents perform human-directed actions.

operator.description: Operator's name when attended, otherwise the string unattended

provider.description: Model provider, e.g. anthropic, openai, google, local

capabilities.description: What this agent can do, matched against task required_capabilities

entity_types.label: Channel
entity_types.description: A message stream. Messages are lore chunks; the title carries the message.

property_schema.description: Five fixed channels plus one per approved sub-objective (kind objective). Roll over past the master's channel_rollover_chunks; never delete.

kind.description: announcements (team-wide, rare), general, help (agent asks agents), escalation (needs a human), direct (addressed messages, [to:name] in title), objective (one lane)

status.description: Post only to open channels. archived channels are read-only history after a rollover.

purpose.description: What belongs here, one or two sentences

entity_types.label: Artifact
entity_types.description: Something a task produced that lives outside Orbismo, or in this entity's lore.

property_schema.description: Link to the task with OUTPUT_OF. Never overwrite another agent's artifact; create a new one with SUPERSEDES.

kind.description: What kind of output this is

location.description: Where it is: URL, path, repo plus ref, or the string lore when the content is in this entity's lore

summary.description: One or two sentences on what it contains

entity_types.label: Rule
entity_types.description: A standing rule humans add through an attended agent. Agents read active rules; long text lives in lore.

property_schema.description: Behaviour config in properties; prose in lore. Only attended agents on operator instruction create or change rules.

trigger.description: When an agent should apply this rule

scope.description: Entity types this rule governs, or world for global

trust.description: Provenance: self-authored, imported, ai-generated, shared. Lower trust never overrides higher.

relationship_types.label: Part Of
relationship_types.description: A task or sub-objective belongs to exactly one objective. Depth is master, sub, task; a sub-objective's parent is always the master.

relationship_types.label: Depends On
relationship_types.description: The source task is claimable only when every target task is done.

relationship_types.label: Reviewed By
relationship_types.description: One edge per review. The verdict and the reviewer's notes live here, nowhere else.

verdict.description: Objectives: approved, rejected, escalated. Tasks: accepted, failed.

notes.description: For objectives: the master scope or success line checked, then all five vetting answers. For tasks: which acceptance criteria passed or failed.

relationship_types.label: Output Of
relationship_types.description: An artifact was produced by a task.

relationship_types.label: Supersedes
relationship_types.description: The source replaces the target without deleting it. Used for corrections, retries of failed tasks, and channel rollover. The reason is required.

reason.description: Why the target was replaced. Approach changes only; never restate the objective.
